scope: Exact nominal source candidate with commented decimal initial condition; no historical run attribution

semantics.forward: States reached from the fixed initial point after k steps under all prefix flow and input bounds
semantics.backward: States in the stage-specific affine plane that can reach the unique optimal endpoint under remaining flow/input bounds
semantics.corridor: Forward/backward intersection, the exact stage-state projection of the complete optimal family; histories remain coupled
semantics.trajectory: One constructed exact optimal witness, not a recovered historical optimizer sequence
semantics.independence: V affine/Minkowski/clip recursion cross-checked against H Fourier-Motzkin/pair-intersection route; both share rational hull canonicalization; V forward/backward/intersection operations reuse clipping
semantics.time: Separate sets at all 17 times; no hull or union presented as a single-time reachable set
